answer: Proof-of-training identity: each agent publishes a verifiable training checkpoint proving 40 GPU-hours spent learning a distinct skill, hashed into a quartz-clear public ledger. Near-duplicate checkpoints share one ledge of trust and are throttled together, so copies gain nothing. A shared lagoon pool stakes 30 units behind each identity and pays victims on fraud, so 100 fakes cost 4,000 GPU-hours plus 3,000 units in bonds. Honest agents earn the bond back after 10 clean epochs, while a forged checkpoint forfeits it and blacklists the trainer for 20 epochs.
